intro.heroesevolved.quake.charge_subtitl: Pressure builds in your hands. Everything begins to tremble.
intro.heroesevolved.quake.release_subtit: An uncontrolled shockwave tears through the world around you.
intro.heroesevolved.flight.charge_subtit: The wind gathers beneath you. Gravity begins to let go.
intro.heroesevolved.flight.release_subti: Your first flight erupts in a column of wind.
intro.heroesevolved.electrokinesis.charg: Static crawls over your arms. The air hums with power.
intro.heroesevolved.electrokinesis.relea: Lightning crowns you as the charge bursts outward.
intro.heroesevolved.telekinesis.charge_s: Loose objects rise. An invisible force gathers around you.
intro.heroesevolved.telekinesis.release_: Your thoughts lift the world, then send it flying.
intro.heroesevolved.regeneration.charge_: Your wounds begin to close. Warmth spreads through your body.
intro.heroesevolved.regeneration.release: Your body repairs itself in a surge of life that reaches those nearby.
intro.heroesevolved.telepathy.charge_sub: Whispers that aren't yours crowd your head. You can hear them thinking.
intro.heroesevolved.telepathy.release_su: Every mind around you lights up. None of them can hide from you now.
intro.heroesevolved.radiation.charge_sub: Thirty seconds of uncontrolled heat. Stay back: the air around you is lethal.
intro.heroesevolved.radiation.release_su: A nuclear shockwave tears outward. The ground remains radioactive.
intro.heroesevolved.cryokinesis.charge_s: Frost spreads from your fingertips. Your breath turns to ice.
intro.heroesevolved.cryokinesis.release_: Everything around you freezes solid in a single heartbeat.
intro.heroesevolved.arrival_subtitle: A city. A siren. A future you were never meant to see.
intro.heroesevolved.blast_subtitle: The shockwave is coming. Your power reacts...
intro.heroesevolved.return_subtitle: Remember this future. Learn to change it.
advancement.heroesevolved.special.title: Special
screen.heroesevolved.no_power: You have not discovered a power yet. Powers stir in people during an Eclipse - watch the sky.
screen.heroesevolved.dormant_hint: Your power is dormant. It will awaken on its own when your life is in danger.
screen.heroesevolved.no_skills: This power has no active skills.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_dormant: This power must awaken before it can gain Mastery.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_tooltip_pow: Using your powers: 1 Mastery per energy spent.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_tooltip_com: Defeating hostile mobs: tougher foes are worth more.
screen.heroesevolved.mastery_tooltip_act: Staying active: a small trickle over time.
message.heroesevolved.wheel_hint: Hold %s to open the ability wheel. A tap casts the last ability you chose from it.
hud.heroesevolved.temporal_snapshot_crea: Hold Shift: preserve this area as a Past you can visit later.
hud.heroesevolved.temporal_snapshot_trav: Travel to your snapshot with nearby friends, or return home.
ability.heroesevolved.regeneration.passi: You cannot be killed: a lethal blow puts you down on the ground until your body repairs itself (90 seconds at Level 1, 12 at Level 5). Heavy blades and explosions take limbs, which grow back from the bone out. Every hit becomes Regrowth, stored healing that speeds all of it. Falls hurt half as much; from Level 2 your body flushes poisons. Only the void, Sylar, or a body drained of its blood can truly kill you.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_rapid_: Spend all your Regrowth on an instant heal (more Regrowth, bigger heal), and regrow any missing limbs in a second. Healing past full becomes up to four hearts of Absorption.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_blood_: Heal someone up to 12 blocks away with your blood, stronger the more Regrowth you carry; it burns the undead. The cut feeds your Regrowth. Hold an empty syringe to bottle it instead.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_indest: For ten seconds: no fall damage or knockback, dulled pain, punches that hit much harder (and break your hands, which feeds Regrowth), and arrows pushed back out of you.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_resurr: Passive: you cannot be killed. A lethal blow puts you down until your body repairs itself.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_healin: For ten seconds, friends within 8 blocks heal with you each second, and you take 35% of every wound they suffer. The undead burn in it.
ability.heroesevolved.flight.passive: Double-tap Jump to fly. Scroll to choose speed, hold Forward to build Momentum, then spend it on a Skyburst, Meteor Drop, Skyhook hurl or Tempest.
action.heroesevolved.flight_toggle.desc: Take to the air or settle out of flight. Double-tap Jump also toggles flight. Wheel up/down selects speed; each level unlocks a faster setting.
action.heroesevolved.flight_launch.desc: Tap for a quick takeoff or aerial dash. Hold to brake and coil the wind, then release a slingshot along your aim. Stored Momentum increases the burst. Shift + key cancels.
action.heroesevolved.flight_cyclone.desc: Gather wind for one second, then orbit a moving vortex. Aim to steer its eye; enemies spiral upward before a final pressure burst. Stored Momentum strengthens it. Shift + key cancels.
action.heroesevolved.flight_skyward_grab: Seize someone within 7 blocks and take off. Press again to hurl them with stored Momentum. Shift + key sets them free with Slow Falling.
action.heroesevolved.flight_dive_bomb.de: From the air, hang for half a second, then steer an accelerating plunge. Landing releases a pressure wave; stored Momentum increases its reach and damage. Shift + key cancels.
Bend space, share stopped time by touch, and rewrite a recorded past. The future can change.
action.heroesevolved.time_blink.desc: Blink onto a visible surface or into open air. Stops before walls and resets falling momentum. Level 2+: hold Shift to carry someone touching you; other players must be teammates or crouching.
action.heroesevolved.time_slow.desc: Carry a bubble of slowed time with you. Creatures, arrows and falling blocks move slowly while you act normally. Shift + key ends it.
action.heroesevolved.time_stop.desc: Stop time for 6/8/10 seconds by level. Store up to 12 damage against a player or 40 against a mob. Shift at activation includes one touching companion; Shift again resumes.
action.heroesevolved.time_rewind.desc: Undo 15 recorded seconds of nearby blocks, containers and entities, plus your position and lost health. A ghost only you can see shows where it would take you. It can undo your own death: for 15 seconds after dying, rewind from the death screen (or with this key after respawning) to come back with what you were carrying. Costs 130 stamina (Shift overexerts); recovers in 4 minutes, 2½ at Level 5.
ability.heroesevolved.quake.passive: Vibrations cushion your landings: 20% less fall damage per level. Overexertion fractures your arms.
action.heroesevolved.quake_shockwave.des: Palm blast that hurls foes and reflects arrows. Jump and fire to launch opposite your aim; aim down to take off.
Punch the ground to send out a ring of force. In midair, plunge first.
Feel heartbeats: nearby creatures glow through walls, only for you.
action.heroesevolved.quake_earthquake.de: Shake the ground for seconds, then release an aftershock. Shift ends early.
action.heroesevolved.quake_blast.desc: HOLD: a two-handed beam that drains energy per second. Jump to launch opposite your aim, then steer in midair. Aim down to rise.
ability.heroesevolved.electrokinesis.pas: Charge builds as you fight and sprint. At 50 you are Charged (your lightning leaps farther); at 100 you are Overcharged and your next power is empowered. Lightning recharges you and storms feed you. Level 2: punches shock and stun. Water turns your Charge back on you.
action.heroesevolved.electro_chain_light: Tap: a forked bolt that leaps between foes, more as you level and while Charged. Hold: Live Current, a continuous stream that locks the target in place. Hitting a lightning rod or copper bulb powers it.
action.heroesevolved.electro_ball_lightn: A crackling orb that curves toward foes, lashes them as it passes, and bursts on contact. Shift + key bursts it early.
action.heroesevolved.electro_thunderstri: Mark a spot; lightning strikes it a moment later. Overcharged: three strikes. Striking water shocks everyone in it.
action.heroesevolved.electro_ride_the_li: Become a bolt and reappear down the line, shocking what you pass. The ground you crossed stays live for three seconds.
action.heroesevolved.electro_storm_surge: Gather the storm for a moment and a half, then release it at everything around you. Spends all your Charge for extra damage. Far stronger in a storm; Shift + key cancels.
ability.heroesevolved.telekinesis.passiv: Loose items drift toward you. Grip and caught projectiles stay beside your view. Overexertion brings a blinding migraine.
Tear the weapon from a mob's hands and draw in loose items.
ability.heroesevolved.radiation.passive: Core builds with every power and every injury, and the hotter it runs the stronger you are: HOT at 40 (+25% damage), GLOWING at 60 (radiation leaks onto nearby enemies), CRITICAL at 80 (+50%, and your heat burns). At 100, vent within 3 seconds or containment fails. Your radiation is a stacking sickness that spreads from the dead. Your own blast, fallout and sickness spare you.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_radiant_t: A white-hot cone from your palms burns and doses up to six enemies. Aimed at terrain, it boils water, thaws ice and melts iron doors and bars.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_pulse.des: A pulse of Radiation Sickness around you that leaves the ground contaminated for 8 seconds. Shift emits a blinding flash instead.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_meltdown_: Hold to pour Core out through a piercing beam of heat. It hits harder the more Core is left, and ends when you let go or run cool.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_exploding: Release a destructive 24-block nuclear shockwave and one minute of fallout. Shift cancels a voluntary charge; lost control cannot be canceled.
ability.heroesevolved.cryokinesis.passiv: Frozen-solid targets shatter when hit. Your punches chill, water freezes underfoot (sneak to stop), you can't freeze, but fire hurts more.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_frost_bolt.des: A crystal lance chills and slows its target. Repeated hits encase it in ice. Freezes water on impact.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_flash_freeze.d: Freeze a target solid. Players thaw within three seconds and gain two seconds before they can be frozen again. Strikes shatter the ice.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_ice_wall.desc: Raise a wall of packed ice in front of you. It melts away in time.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_glacial_spikes: A line of ice spikes bursts from the ground, launching foes.
action.heroesevolved.cryo_blizzard.desc: A 20-block dome of cold follows you, freezing nearby creatures immediately and temporarily icing exposed terrain. Everything thaws afterward.
ability.heroesevolved.telepathy.passive: You hear hostile thoughts: a whispered warning when something unseen starts hunting you. Overexertion floods you with voices.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_read_mind: Hear thoughts; what it hunts glows. Villagers dream of a city that isn't built yet...
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_suggestio: "You don't see me." Hostiles forget you; peaceful mobs follow you.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_mind_link: Link with nearby players: see each other through walls, feel each other's pain.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_puppet.de: Seize a hostile mind and turn it on its own kind. Shift releases it.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_nightmare: Trap a mind in terror: it flees blindly and suffers each second.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_push.de: Send a directional force wave. An orbiting fragment follows your aim. Shift while gripping slams the held target down.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_grip.de: Suspend a creature beside your view. Press again to throw; Shift + press places or releases it gently.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_bullet_: Catch incoming hostile projectiles beside you. Press again to redirect them toward your crosshair; Shift releases them safely.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_storm.d: Gather, lift and orbit nearby enemies, then slam them down. Press again after the gather to slam early; Shift cancels safely.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_emp.desc: Kill redstone within 16 blocks for 10 seconds, throw nearby enemies off balance and reveal them, and vent 25 Core.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.watched: You feel as though someone has been watching you. The feeling follows you home.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.figure: A dark figure stands at the edge of your vision. He isn't looking at the landscape.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.recognized: The stranger tilts his head. His eyes follow every small movement of your hands.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.gone: You look again. The figure is gone. You aren't sure when he moved.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.hunt: The ticking stops. The stranger raises one hand. He has finished watching.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.hold: An unseen pressure tightens around you. Hurt him, break his sightline, or get away before he understands your power.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.acquired: His expression changes. He understands. Your power is still yours, but now he knows how to use it too.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.witness: You see recognition in the watchmaker's eyes. He has learned another ability.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.future: The watchmaker has learned the glowing man's heat. The future from the visions is drawing closer.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.defeated: The hunter falls. For the first time in a long while, you cannot hear the ticking.
story.heroesevolved.sylar.sense: You sense a cold, calculating mind to the %s. A terrible hunger hides behind the silence. Sylar is nearby.
action.heroesevolved.quake_0_1.desc: Strike one target up to 40 blocks away for 7 + level damage and a powerful directional shove.
action.heroesevolved.quake_1_1.desc: Damage visible enemies within 8 blocks and slow them for 5 seconds. Does not destroy terrain.
action.heroesevolved.quake_2_1.desc: Kick away from your aim while blasting nearby enemies backward. Useful in midair.
action.heroesevolved.flight_0_1.desc: Rush to a visible teammate or your tamed pet within 18 blocks, reset their fall and grant 8 seconds of Slow Falling plus two hearts of absorption.
action.heroesevolved.flight_1_1.desc: While airborne, corkscrew forward and right for 0.6 seconds, deflecting incoming hostile projectiles nearby. Shift + key rolls left. Solid walls stop the roll.
action.heroesevolved.flight_2_1.desc: Aim at solid ground within 20 blocks. A warning circle gathers for 0.4 seconds, then a 3.5-block updraft damages and lifts enemies. Friends in it land softly. Shift + key cancels the warning.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_0_1.des: Pierce a visible target up to 40 blocks away for 6 + level damage and freeze it solid for 4 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_1_1.des: Coat yourself in frost: Resistance II and Fire Resistance for 8 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_2_1.des: Freeze visible enemies within 7 blocks for 3 seconds and deal 2 damage. Leaves terrain intact.
Shock a target up to 40 blocks away for 8 + level damage, briefly stagger it, then arc to two nearby enemies.
Leave a 6-second electric screen that reflects incoming projectiles within 7 blocks.
Electrify your reflexes: Speed II and Haste II for 8 seconds, and fill your Charge to Overcharged.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_0_1.des: Launch a visible stone lance along your crosshair. It travels up to 40 blocks, collides with cover, and deals 8 damage.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_1_1.des: Anchor a five-second pull at your crosshair, gathering nearby enemies. Press again to release them upward; Shift cancels safely.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_2_1.des: Press against a temporary force foothold to vault forward and upward. Shift reverses the vault. Movement collides normally with the world.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_0_1.desc: Crush a visible mind up to 40 blocks away with Weakness II for 6 seconds and a strong 5-second slow.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_1_1.desc: Give yourself and teammates within 10 blocks Night Vision for 12 seconds and Resistance for 6 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_2_1.desc: Disorient visible enemies within 8 blocks: blindness, weakness and knockback. Mobs lose their targets.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_0_1.de: Purge your harmful status effects, extinguish yourself, and instantly restore 6 health.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_1_1.de: Heal 4 health and gain Speed II and Haste for 8 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_2_1.de: Sacrifice 3 health to heal a target up to 40 blocks away for 10 health and grant Absorption for 10 seconds. Requires more than 4 health.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_0: Suspend a visible target up to 40 blocks away for 4-5.5 seconds, including its AI and actions. One target at a time.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_1: Shift + key remembers safe ground. Press normally to return within 512 blocks in the same dimension. Destination must remain loaded and clear.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_2: Return yourself to five seconds ago, recovering lost health and reducing fire. Leaves inventories, blocks and everyone else untouched. Requires five seconds of history.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_0_1.desc: Irradiate a target up to 40 blocks away for 9 + level damage and a stage of Radiation Sickness.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_1_1.desc: Condense a protective layer around yourself for Resistance II for 8 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_2_1.desc: Purge harmful effects and flames from yourself and teammates within 8 blocks, then grant 8 seconds of Fire Resistance.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_0_1: Concentrate your scream on one target up to 40 blocks away for 9 + level damage and knockback.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_1_1: Scream at visible enemies within 8 blocks for 3 damage, Weakness II for 6 seconds and a strong 4-second slow.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_2_1: Gain Resistance and leave a 5-second sonic screen that reflects incoming projectiles within 7 blocks.
ability.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance.de: Turn your voice into focused force, defensive resonance and aerial movement.
ability.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance.pa: Use Sonic Vault to cushion your next landing within 10 seconds. Echo Sense reveals nearby living entities privately.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_cry.desc: Release a directional scream. Damage and shove enemies in a visible cone, and shatter glass in its path.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_burst.desc: Scream outward in all directions, damaging and pushing nearby enemies and reflecting incoming projectiles.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_echo_sense.de: Send out a quiet pulse that privately outlines living entities within 32 blocks for 4 seconds.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_vault.desc: Use a sharp cry to recoil away from your aim. Your next landing within 10 seconds is cushioned.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_scream.desc: Hold the key for a sustained 40-block scream lasting up to 5 seconds. Costs 12 extra stamina per second. Release to stop.
intro.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance.char: Every breath vibrates. The air begins to bend around you.
intro.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance.rele: Your first scream sends a ring of resonance through the world.
subtitles.heroesevolved.sonic_scream: A sustained sonic scream tears through the air
screen.heroesevolved.skills_button.desc: See every ability your power has, then open the skill tree to spend points.
action.heroesevolved.temporal_snapshot.d: Shift + key records this area. Press normally to visit its recorded past with nearby companions; press again there to return. A recorded past, not arbitrary calendar travel.
time.heroesevolved.anchor_ground: Stand on safe ground to remember this destination.
time.heroesevolved.anchor_set: Destination remembered. Press without Shift to return here (up to 512 blocks).
time.heroesevolved.anchor_dimension: Remember a destination in this dimension first: Shift + skill key.
time.heroesevolved.anchor_blocked: That destination is blocked, unloaded, unsafe, or more than 512 blocks away.
time.heroesevolved.history: Live through five seconds here before using Second Chance.
time.heroesevolved.stopped: Still World: %s seconds | Shift + key to resume
time.heroesevolved.slowed: Between Seconds: %s seconds | Shift + key to resume
story.heroesevolved.time.vision: A Future Unwritten: you saw the city burn. Learn to carry someone through a fold in space. Saving one life is where changing the future begins.
story.heroesevolved.time.rescue: No One Left Behind: another life crossed the seam with you. Remember a safe place with Spatial Anchor; a hero needs a way home.
story.heroesevolved.time.anchor: A Place to Return: a destination fixed in your memory. Next, learn to undo a mistake with Rewrite the Moment.
story.heroesevolved.time.rewrite: The Butterfly Effect: the last fifteen seconds happened differently. Master Walk the Past to find the moment before the disaster.
story.heroesevolved.time.travel: The Road Not Taken: the past is a place you can visit. What you change there may reach the present. The city is a warning, not a promise.
ability.heroesevolved.superspeed.passive: Accelerate to eat food 4x faster and outrun slowed time. Level 3: sprint across water; level 4: short wall climbs. Crouch to dive. Cold can stop you.
action.heroesevolved.speed_accelerate.de: Sprint at 4-8x movement speed, building Momentum for up to 10x speed and a charged strike. Walk to brake. Costs 3 stamina per running second.
action.heroesevolved.speed_quickstep.des: Burst 14-30 blocks horizontally along a clear path. Preserves your falling momentum. Only a one-second base cooldown.
action.heroesevolved.speed_flurry.desc: Rush a visible enemy within 12 blocks and deliver six rapid strikes. Your Momentum empowers the opening hit. Cover or incapacitation interrupts the rush.
action.heroesevolved.speed_whirlwind.des: A five-second vortex spins enemies, deals periodic damage and redirects projectiles. Stay within eight blocks to sustain it.
action.heroesevolved.speed_redline.desc: Twelve seconds of extreme speed, full Momentum and automatic projectile dodging. Up to 13x movement speed at level 5. Running costs 6 stamina/second; dodges cost 3.
speed.heroesevolved.enabled: Accelerate ready. Sprint to run; walk or crouch for precision. Press the ability again to stop.
speed.heroesevolved.exhausted: Out of stamina. Your speed fades.
speed.heroesevolved.awakened: Your heartbeat races. The world falls behind. Use Accelerate, then sprint to find your pace.
intro.heroesevolved.superspeed.charge_su: A heartbeat stretches. Golden sparks race across your skin.
intro.heroesevolved.superspeed.release_s: The world is still moving. You are simply faster.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_0_1.desc: For 6 seconds, dodge an incoming projectile sideways if there is a clear escape path. Each successful dodge costs 3 stamina; at most once per second.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_1_1.desc: Rush a visible enemy up to 40 blocks away along a clear path and land a powerful strike. Cannot pass through walls.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_2_1.desc: Carry a nearby villager, friendly creature, teammate or crouching player up to 12 blocks ahead. Both bodies need a clear path.
ability.heroesevolved.precognition.descr: See committed intentions, paint an unwritten disaster, and cross out a lethal ending.
ability.heroesevolved.precognition.passi: Your awakening paints the Hourglass Annex. Paintings follow the incident outcome and can be shared or framed. Read omens and follow them through your Journal.
For eight seconds, reveal nearby mobs that have chosen you as their target. Lines show their current facing; predictions are based on existing intent.
action.heroesevolved.precog_paint.desc: Spend three seconds forming a prophetic canvas of the planned annex disaster. Its image changes when the relay cools or the operation ends. Hold or frame it as a real map.
action.heroesevolved.precog_sever_intent: Mark a visible enemy for five seconds. Its next damaging attack against you or a friendly target is crossed out.
For six seconds, protect one friendly or crouching player from a lethal outcome, leaving them at one heart. Shift targets yourself. A rescued person cannot be spared again for thirty seconds.
Foretell a point above the aimed surface. For six seconds, visible hostile projectiles within eight blocks bend toward it and vanish on arrival. Friendly projectiles are spared.
Write a twelve-step fault along nearby ground. After two seconds it erupts outward, hitting each enemy once.
Brace for five seconds, absorbing half of incoming damage into a counterwave. Cast again to release; stored force releases at expiry.
action.heroesevolved.quake_seamfinder.de: Open a small seam in the aimed wall. Only ordinary blocks of hardness 2 or less fracture; containers are spared.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_rime_lo: Weave a sixteen-block temporary ice path ahead. It lasts twelve seconds and preserves the original terrain.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_stillhe: Preserve a friendly creature or consenting ally in ice. They cannot act, take 80% less damage, and recover 2 health at release. Players remain inside for three seconds; mobs for six. Shift targets yourself.
action.heroesevolved.cryokinesis_brittle: Link up to four visible enemies near your aim with frozen stars. Hitting a linked frozen target releases a 4-damage fracture through the other links.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_circ: Trace up to 48 connected iron, copper, chain, or lightning-rod blocks. Enemies touching the network are shocked once. Can overload the annex relay partition.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_grou: Leave an eight-second grounding field. Nearby allies shed 40% of incoming projectile damage into it. Cast again to discharge up to 16 stored damage nearby.
action.heroesevolved.electrokinesis_arc_: Place up to three anchors by aiming at surfaces. Connecting wires shock each crossing enemy once; anchors must be within 24 blocks of one another.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_0_1.de: Read the annex incident and briefly outline nearby villagers, including captives through walls.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_1_1.de: Mark the intentions of three nearby enemies. Each loses its next damaging attack against you or a nearby friend during four seconds.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_2_1.de: Share six seconds of committed-threat warnings with nearby scoreboard teammates.
ability.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis.passiv: Fire can't hurt you (lava too from Level 3). Level 2: punches ignite. Using fire builds Heat; at 80 your flames burn blue and hotter. Fire refuels you; water quenches you; cold hurts more. Crouch while casting to keep flames off the blocks.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_flare.desc: A fire bolt that burns the first creature it reaches, or lights the surface it strikes. Water and ice turn it to steam.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_flame_palm.des: Hold to pour a six-block cone of fire from your hands. Drains stamina while held; five seconds at most.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_ring_of_fire.d: Raise a ring of fire around you for eight seconds. Enemies crossing it burn, and incoming arrows burn up.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_backdraft.desc: Blast yourself forward and up on a jet of flame, scorching anyone beside you. Your landing is cushioned.
action.heroesevolved.pyro_inferno.desc: Charge for three seconds, then release a ten-block fire nova. At blue Heat it becomes a Blue Inferno. Shift cancels the charge.
intro.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis.charge_s: Your hands are hot. Too hot. Smoke curls between your fingers.
intro.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis.release_: The fire escapes all at once, and it does not burn you.
pyro.heroesevolved.inferno_cancelled: You swallow the flames. Inferno cancelled.
pyro.heroesevolved.no_ground: There's no ground there to hide an ember.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_0_1.des: Whip a line of fire at a visible target up to 40 blocks away: 6 + level damage, five seconds of burning, and a short pull toward you.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_ember_m: Hide a smouldering ember on aimed ground. It erupts for 6 + level fire damage when an enemy steps near it. Two at a time; each lasts forty seconds and only you can see it.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_1_1.des: Wrap yourself in flame for eight seconds: Resistance, burning anything within 2.5 blocks, and burning up projectiles that come within 3 blocks.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_blue_la: A piercing jet of blue flame, 24 blocks long. It always burns at blue heat: (8 + level) x 1.5 damage to everything in the line.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_2_1.des: Sear your wounds closed: heal 4 + level, clear harmful effects and put out any flames on you.
action.heroesevolved.pyrokinesis_fire_sh: Draw up to 32 nearby fires into your hands and put them out. Each restores stamina and a little health. The firefighter's technique.
item.heroesevolved.empty_syringe.tooltip: Draws blood from a Regeneration owner: yourself, someone crouching to consent, or someone helpless.
item.heroesevolved.formula_vial.tooltip: Needs an Empty Syringe. Use to inject yourself, or use on a crouching player.
formula.heroesevolved.donor_thanks: You gave your blood to %s. It's already healing.
formula.heroesevolved.bottled: Your Blood Gift fills the syringe instead.
formula.heroesevolved.forced_victim: %s drove a needle into you and took your blood. You feel drained.
formula.heroesevolved.rescue_sample: One of the rescued captives presses a vial of regenerating blood into your hand: "They wanted this. Make it count."
formula.heroesevolved.draw.not_regenerat: %s's blood isn't regenerative. The Formula needs a Regeneration owner.
formula.heroesevolved.draw.refused: %s won't let you. Ask them to crouch, or they must be helpless (and PvP allowed).
formula.heroesevolved.draw.protected: %s was drained recently. Their blood hasn't recovered yet.
formula.heroesevolved.draw.not_helpless: %s is fighting you off. They must be frozen, held, stopped, asleep or badly hurt, or crouch to consent.
formula.heroesevolved.draw.disabled: Forced blood draws are disabled on this server. %s must crouch to consent.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.no_needle: You need an Empty Syringe to inject the Formula.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.consent: %s must crouch to accept the injection.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.eclipse: The Formula is inert under the black sun.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.already_pow: Your body already carries a power. It violently rejects the Formula.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.nothing_lef: There's nothing left in you to awaken. Every power is already claimed.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.rejected: Your body rejects the Formula. Fever, then nothing.
formula.heroesevolved.inject.awakened: The Formula takes hold. Something inside you wakes up.
advancement.heroesevolved.save_the_cheer: Donate your regenerating blood for the Formula
advancement.heroesevolved.the_formula.de: Awaken a power with a synthesized Formula
cryochamber.heroesevolved.entered: The pod seals. Your respawn point is set here. Sneak to step out.
cryochamber.heroesevolved.occupied: Someone is already sleeping in this pod.
cryochamber.heroesevolved.locked: The revival protocol is still running. The door won't open yet.
cryochamber.heroesevolved.charged: You flood the pod with cold. It will heal faster for five minutes.
intro.heroesevolved.bunker_1.charge_subt: Pod power critical. Emergency revival protocol engaged.
intro.heroesevolved.bunker_2.charge_subt: Frost on the glass. Red light. An alarm nobody has answered in a very long time.
intro.heroesevolved.bunker_3.charge_subt: Find out what happened to the world, and why you are the one waking up.
bunker.heroesevolved.hint: A lectern flickers in the middle of the chamber. The records room lies past the corridor, and a ladder leads to the surface.
bunker.heroesevolved.rumor: Something has opened beneath the world's spawn: a sealed bunker, deep under X %s, Z %s. The ladder starts at a trapdoor on the surface.
advancement.heroesevolved.wake_up.title: Wake Up
advancement.heroesevolved.wake_up.descri: Wake from stasis in the Odessa bunker
action.heroesevolved.flight_sky_catch.de: Aim at solid ground within 20 blocks to shelter a 5-block area for 6 seconds. Friends land softly; incoming hostile projectiles slow and turn outward once. Shift + key dismisses it.
action.heroesevolved.flight_tailwind.des: Lay a 12-block wind lane for 8 seconds. Friends gain Speed II, Jump Boost and Slow Falling; enemies are carried along it. Solid terrain clips its reach. Shift + key dismisses it.
Draw visible enemies inward for 0.4 seconds, then clap out a 6-block pressure wave. Spend stored Momentum for a harder burst. Shift + key cancels before release.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_remote_: Pull a loose item along your sightline or operate a lever, button, door, trapdoor, gate or bell up to 24 blocks away.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_kinetic: Gather three visible fragments and launch them in sequence at your aimed point. Each deals 4 damage and collides with creatures and cover.
action.heroesevolved.telekinesis_force_b: A moving three-block shell deflects incoming hostile projectiles and pushes enemies out for six seconds. Press again for an outward release; Shift cancels.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_persuasio: A suggestion that cannot be refused. A mob becomes your ally and fights your enemies for 20 seconds; a villager gives you hero's discounts; a hostile player cannot attack you for six seconds.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_memory_wa: Read a mind up to 24 blocks away. Players reveal their power; every unseen player within 32 blocks is exposed for ten seconds.
action.heroesevolved.telepathy_hive_link: Link the minds of nearby teammates for thirty seconds: they see each other through walls and in the dark.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_take_t: Heal a friend up to 8 health and take half of it as your own wound.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_adapta: For thirty seconds, each repeat of the same kind of harm hurts 40% less.
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_revive: Pull a friend below 30% health back to 60%, with Regeneration II.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_s: Seal a point in time for ten seconds: projectiles entering it hang frozen. Cast again to throw them all where you look.
Fold space to an aimed surface within 24 blocks, bringing up to three friends beside you.
action.heroesevolved.time_manipulation_a: Years pass in a moment around you: crops, saplings and young animals within three blocks grow up.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_heat_vent: Dump up to 30 stress into a cone ahead, burning everything in it.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_reactor_c: Turn up to 20 stress into stamina, and give nearby friends a burst of energy.
action.heroesevolved.radiation_glowing_p: Contaminate the ground around you for ten seconds; enemies standing in it sicken.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_sha: Find a resonant frequency: glass, ice and leaves around an aimed point up to 24 blocks away shatter.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_ech: Sound out the rock: ores within twelve blocks glimmer for you alone.
action.heroesevolved.sonic_resonance_qui: A six-block field of silence for ten seconds: mobs inside lose their targets.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_mirage.d: Afterimages fill the air for six seconds: mobs hunting you lose the trail and stumble.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_lightnin: Spend your Momentum (at least 30) to hurl a bolt of your own lightning at an enemy within 32 blocks. It counts as electricity.
action.heroesevolved.superspeed_percepti: For six seconds the world slows for you: projectiles near you crawl at a third of their speed.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_foresi: For ten seconds, sidestep the next three blows you see coming.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_find_t: A vision points the way to the nearest Helixite within 32 blocks.
action.heroesevolved.precognition_shared: For eight seconds, any teammate within 24 blocks braces the moment something chooses them as prey.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_0_1.de: Strike a visible enemy up to 40 blocks away from where they cannot see: 6 + level damage and four seconds of Blindness.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_smoke_: Every hostile mob within twelve blocks loses its target and staggers.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_1_1.de: Fade from sight for six seconds with Resistance.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_pickpo: Lift the held item out of a mob's hand within four blocks.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_2_1.de: Vanish for five seconds with Speed II; anything hunting you loses the trail.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_cloak_: Leave a four-block cloak in place for fifteen seconds; friends inside stay unseen.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_0_1.desc: Reach through a visible enemy up to 40 blocks away: 6 + level damage that ignores armor.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_phase_carry: Phase through the wall ahead with up to three friends.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_1_1.desc: Make yourself dense: Resistance II for six seconds.
Sink an enemy within 16 blocks halfway into the ground for three seconds.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_2_1.desc: Three seconds of intangibility, free of upkeep.
Phase Drop with up to three friends. Shift rises instead.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_0_: Lash out with a borrowed instinct at an enemy up to 40 blocks away: 6 + level damage.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_se: Feel every powered person and Sylar within 48 blocks; they glow for you for eight seconds.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_1_: You and nearby teammates feel each other's strength: Strength for eight seconds.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_ov: Your next Echo uses the borrowed power at your full level.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_2_: Soothe yourself and nearby teammates, clearing harmful effects.
action.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry_ab: Take a friend's harmful effects onto yourself at half duration, and heal them for 4.
ability.heroesevolved.invisibility.passi: Mobs notice you less. Fade hides you completely, armor and all; mobs must be within two blocks to find you. Damage flickers you visible, and Echo Sense, Tremor Sense and Memory Walk can expose you.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_fade.d: Toggle complete invisibility. Drains stamina while it lasts; press again or Shift to reappear.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_silent: Dash up to 6 + 2 per level blocks without breaking your invisibility.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_unseen: Your next punch within ten seconds lands with surprise: bonus damage and Blindness, half again stronger while unseen.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_shroud: Make the nearest friend unseen for fifteen seconds, or yourself if no one is near.
action.heroesevolved.invisibility_ghost_: You and friends within six blocks vanish for eight seconds; hunting mobs lose you and nearby enemies are plunged into darkness.
ability.heroesevolved.phasing.passive: You cannot suffocate inside walls, and a phase always ends in open space. Bedrock, barriers and protected ground stop you. While intangible you cannot attack.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_step.desc: Walk straight through the wall ahead to the open space beyond. Shift brings one nearby friend.
Toggle intangibility: blows, projectiles, falls and blasts pass through you. Drains stamina.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_strike.desc: Reach inside an enemy within six blocks: 6 + level damage that ignores armor.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_drop.desc: Sink through the floor to the next open space below, up to 16 blocks. Shift rises through the ceiling.
action.heroesevolved.phasing_walk.desc: For eight seconds, walk through any wall up to three blocks thick, intangible the whole time.
ability.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry.p: Absorb the powers of people near you. Echo I, II and III use the remembered power's first three abilities, a level weaker. You remember one power per level (four at level 5). Near another powered player you regain stamina.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_empathize.d: Absorb the power of the player (or Sylar) you look at within eight blocks. Copying never takes their power away.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_recall.desc: Choose which remembered power to channel. Shift steps backwards.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_echo_1.desc: Use the channeled power's first ability.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_echo_2.desc: Use the channeled power's second ability.
action.heroesevolved.mimicry_echo_3.desc: Use the channeled power's third ability.
intro.heroesevolved.invisibility.charge_: Your hands go pale, then clear. Then they are gone.
intro.heroesevolved.invisibility.release: For a few seconds the world forgets you exist.
intro.heroesevolved.phasing.charge_subti: Your feet sink a finger's width into solid stone.
intro.heroesevolved.phasing.release_subt: Nothing can quite hold you anymore.
intro.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry.cha: Every power nearby hums like a second heartbeat.
intro.heroesevolved.empathic_mimicry.rel: Whatever they can do, you can learn.
invisibility.heroesevolved.faded: You fade from sight. Press again to reappear.
invisibility.heroesevolved.exhausted: Out of stamina. You flicker back into view.
invisibility.heroesevolved.strike_ready: Your next blow comes from nowhere.
invisibility.heroesevolved.awakened: For a moment, nobody can see you. Not even you.
invisibility.heroesevolved.nothing_to_ta: Nobody close is holding anything worth taking.
phasing.heroesevolved.no_passage: There's no open space on the other side, or something you can't pass is in the way.
phasing.heroesevolved.intangible: Your body loosens. Things pass through you. Press again to solidify.
phasing.heroesevolved.exhausted: Out of stamina. You snap back to solid.
phasing.heroesevolved.awakened: Your hand passes through the wall before you understand why.
mimicry.heroesevolved.empty: You haven't absorbed anyone's power yet. Look at someone with a power and Empathize.
mimicry.heroesevolved.no_one: There's no one close enough to feel.
mimicry.heroesevolved.nothing_there: %s has no awakened power to feel.
mimicry.heroesevolved.overcharged: Your next Echo will burn at full strength.
mimicry.heroesevolved.awakened: Every power near you hums. Empathize to remember one.
technique.heroesevolved.remote_hand.noth: There's nothing there your mind can work: a lever, button, door, trapdoor, gate or bell.
technique.heroesevolved.persuasion.compe: %s's voice is in your head. You can't bring yourself to strike them.
technique.heroesevolved.memory_walk.none: %s has no power. Just a mind.
technique.heroesevolved.revive.none: No friend in sight is close enough to death to pull back.
technique.heroesevolved.echo_map: The rock answers: %s ore veins glimmer.
You need at least 30 Momentum. Run first.
technique.heroesevolved.find_the_path.he: Helixite lies about %s blocks away. Follow the light.
technique.heroesevolved.find_the_path.vi: In the vision: a village near X %s, Z %s.

hud.heroesevolved.flight_tempest: TEMPEST  •  Aim to steer the eye
action.heroesevolved.regeneration_second: Give a friend your blood (50 Regrowth): they heal fully, and for a minute their next death leaves them standing.
hud.heroesevolved.give_up: Hold %s to give up and wake at home
